card.name: Linking words in NSAID risk warnings
card.fires_on: The words "the" or "which" in set NSAID warning sentences. Mostly "the" in "lowest effective dosage for the shortest possible duration", and "which" after "large intestine," before "can be fatal".

modes.label: Dose for the shortest duration
modes.description: The word "the" after "lowest effective dose(age) for" just before "shortest possible duration".
modes.example: • Use the lowest effective dosage for<< the>> shortest possible duration.

modes.label: Which can be fatal
modes.description: The word "which" after a list of GI organs in the bleeding, ulceration and perforation warning.
modes.example: perforation of the stomach, small intestine, or large intestine,<< which>> can be fatal.

card.plain: It marks a small linking word in the standard NSAID stomach-bleeding and heart-risk warning sentences.
